summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders, the 2026 Management Information Circular, form of proxy, and financial statements request form. The meeting, scheduled for June 11, 2026, covers routine items: receiving audited financials, setting board size at eight, electing directors, appointing an auditor, approving the Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, and an advisory vote on executive compensation. The company uses notice-and-access for delivery. No special situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, etc.) is disclosed. This is a routine annual meeting filing with no deal terms or unusual structural changes. What to watch: None.
